description_en: Used to verify a company name, company certificate number, and the name of the company's legal representative. Verification passes only when all three are consistent and the company's operating status is in business
description_zh: 用于核验企业名称、企业证件号和企业法人姓名，必须全部一致且企业经营状态为在营才会判定核验通过
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi company-three-elements-verification --ep-cert-no 92420320000000J627 --ep-cert-name '某企业' --legal-person-cert-name '张三' --auth-code Dd1r0004id --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CompanyThreeElementsVerification

parameters.help_en:
The name of the company's legal representative.
If the company has multiple legal representatives, separate the names with the Chinese enumeration comma ("、")
parameters.help_zh:
企业法人姓名。
如果企业有多个法人，法人之间需用中文顿号（”、”）隔开
parameters.name: legal_person_cert_name

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

Log on to the Cell Phone Number Service console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.608385.0.0.79847f8b3awqUC) and go to the My Applications (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply) page to obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

登录号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.608385.0.0.79847f8b3awqUC)，在我的申请 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

EnterpriseStatus.description_en: The operating status of the company

OpenTime.description_en: The business term of the company

InconsistentData.description_en: The fields whose verification results are inconsistent

items.description_en:
EpCertName: the company name
EpCertNo: the company certificate number
CertName: the name of the company's legal representative
items.description_zh:
EpCertName：企业名称
EpCertNo：企业证件号
CertName：企业法人姓名

ReasonCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:

0: The verification is consistent.
1: The verification is consistent, but the company is not operating normally.
2: The person-company verification is inconsistent.
3: The two-element company verification failed.
4: The company is not found.
5: The person does not exist in the database
ReasonCode.description_zh:
核验结果编码。取值：

0：核验一致
1：核验一致，企业非正常营业
2：人企核验不一致
3：企业二要素不通过
4：查无企业
5：人在库中不存在

VerifyResult.description_en:
The verification result. Valid values:

true: The information is consistent and the company is operating normally.
false: The verification failed
VerifyResult.description_zh:
核验结果。取值：

true：信息核验一致，且企业正常经营。
false：核验不通过

Message.description_en: The description of the returned status code

RequestId.description_en: The common parameter. Each request returns a unique ID, which can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求返回的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
